summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found doing a read-only audit first I traced the full chain before proposing anything: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts` → schema. Concretely, as of the current code on `master`:  - The client has **no localStorage/anonymous fallback** for watchlist data (only theme uses localStorage). Every read/write goes through `api.get/post/delete("/watchlist/...")` with `credentials: "include"`. - `App.tsx` gates the entire app behind `user` from `useAuth()` — there'
